 Credit: iStock photos
 The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has declared the final result of the Combined Defence Services (CDS) Examination (I), 2026. Lohitaksh Mahajan has secured the top position in the merit lists for all three academies. 
 ADVERTISEMENT Candidates who appeared for the examination can check the merit lists on the official website, upsc.gov.in .
 The UPSC conducted the CDS (I) written examination in April 2026, followed by interviews by the Services Selection Board (SSB) of the Ministry of Defence. Based on their performance in both stages, 243 candidates have qualified for admission to the 162nd course across three defence academies.
 The merit lists include 155 candidates for the Indian Military Academy (IMA), 63 for the Indian Naval Academy (INA), and 25 for the Air Force Academy (AFA).
 Also Read: Hundred years of UPSC: How India's civil services exam has changed over the years The commission has clarified that some candidates appear in more than one list for different academies.
 UPSC CDS I 2026: Academy-wise vacancies 
 As notified by the government, the vacancies for the three academies are:
 Indian Military Academy, Dehradun: 100 vacancies, including 13 reserved for National Cadet Corps (NCC) 'C' Certificate holders from the Army Wing.
 Indian Naval Academy, Ezhimala: 26 vacancies, including six for NCC 'C' Certificate holders from the Naval Wing and one for the Hydro category.
 Air Force Academy, Hyderabad: 32 vacancies, including three reserved for NCC 'C' Certificate holders from the Air Wing through NCC Special Entry.
 How to check UPSC CDS I Final Result 2026? 
 Candidates can follow these steps to check the result:
 Visit the official UPSC website at upsc.gov.in .
 Open the CDS Examination (I), 2026 final result notification.
 Download the PDF containing the academy-wise merit lists.
 Search for your roll number in the respective list.
 Save the PDF for future reference.
 Also Read: UPSC CSE Prelims 2026: Aspirants approach Rahul Gandhi; flag ‘ambiguous’ questions The UPSC has said that candidates' marks will be made available on its website after the declaration of the final result of the Officers' Training Academy (OTA) course for CDS Examination (I), 2026.
 What happens after the final result? 
 The commission has clarified that the results of the medical examination have not been considered while preparing the merit lists.
 The verification of candidates' dates of birth and educational qualifications is still underway at the Army Headquarters. Therefore, the candidature of all selected candidates remains provisional until the required details are verified.
 Candidates have been asked to submit their original certificates, along with attested photocopies, to the Army Headquarters, Naval Headquarters or Air Headquarters, depending on their first preference.
 Also Read: CLAT 2027: Registration deadline extended to November 7, exam on December 6 Those who have changed their address have also been advised to inform the respective headquarters directly.
 For examination-related queries, candidates can contact the UPSC Facilitation Counter on working days between 10:00 am and 5:30 pm. They can also reach the Candidate Helpdesk at 011-24041001 or 011-40303444 between 9:00 am and 8:00 pm on all days.
